theorems.name: ABI_CLEANSE_EXTENDED_PROJECTION
theorems.statement: !s a s' a'. abi_cleanse_scalar_extended_step (s,a) (s',a') ==> x86 s s'

theorems.name: ABI_CLEANSE_EXTENDED_BACKLIFT_ALL
theorems.statement: !s s' a. x86 s s' ==> abi_cleanse_scalar_extended_step (s,a) (s',a)

theorems.name: ABI_CLEANSE_EXTENDED_EQUIVALENCE
theorems.statement: !s s' a. (?a'. abi_cleanse_scalar_extended_step (s,a) (s',a')) <=> x86 s s'

theorems.name: ABI_CLEANSE_EXTENDED_PROGRESS
theorems.statement:
!s a. (?s'. x86 s s') <=>
        ?s' a'. abi_cleanse_scalar_extended_step (s,a) (s',a')

theorems.name: ABI_CLEANSE_STEP_PRESERVES_OMITTED
theorems.statement:
!s a s' a'. abi_cleanse_scalar_extended_step (s,a) (s',a') /\
             abi_all_decodes_cleanse_scalar s ==> a' = a

theorems.name: ABI_CLEANSE_EQUAL_IMPLIES_REQUIRED_CONTROLS
theorems.statement: !a a'. a' = a ==> abi_required_controls_preserved a a'

theorems.name: ABI_CLEANSE_REGISTERED_SITE_IS_SCALAR
theorems.statement: !off len inst. abi_cleanse_site off len inst ==> abi_cleanse_scalar_instruction inst

theorems.name: ABI_CLEANSE_DECODED_SCALAR_UNIQUE
theorems.statement:
!len inst s. x86_decode s (read RIP s) (len,inst) /\
              abi_cleanse_scalar_instruction inst ==> abi_all_decodes_cleanse_scalar s

theorems.name: ABI_CLEANSE_CHECKED_RUN_LIFT
theorems.statement:
!n P C s a.
    assurance_checked_run n P
      (\k source target. C k source target /\ abi_all_decodes_cleanse_scalar source) s
    ==> eventually_n abi_cleanse_scalar_extended_step n
          (\t. P(FST t) /\ SND t = a) (s,a)
